hersel_marriage_fact.evidence: Delaware Certificate of Marriage, File No. 4339 (FamilySearch, Delaware, Marriage Records, 1913-1954): groom Hersel Davis of Milton, Delaware, age 34, born June 3, 1913, Single, first marriage, farmer, father Morris Davis, mother Hester Davis; bride Myrtle Mosley of Milton, age 34, born September 5, 1913, Single, first marriage, father Harry Mosley, mother Maggie Mosley. Married September 16, 1947, Milton, Broadkill Hundred, Sussex County, by Rev. G. S. Sterling; witness Carrie Sterling. The clerk wrote the groom's surname in a hand that FamilySearch indexed as 'Donis'; the parents, residence, and bride identify the man as Hersel Davis.

maggie.notes: [Created by mosley-davis-marriage package 2026-11-26.] Wife of Harry Mosley of Representative District 8, Sussex County, Delaware. Named as the mother of Myrtle Mosley on Myrtle's 1947 Delaware marriage certificate (File No. 4339), the first primary record to name her. In Harry's census household she appears as Maggie Mosley, age 36 (1920), as Margaret M. Mosley, age 47 (1930), and as Maggie Mosley, age 56 (1940). No other facts are asserted by this package.
